name: City Facilities
description:
City-owned and leased facilities maintained in the City's Facility System of Record (FSR). Does not include the following agencies which are not part of the City and County of San Francisco: SFHA, OCII and City College.
This dataset was developed through a process involving some of the primary stewards for the facility data and their stakeholders. It is meant to be a living reference and will be maintained and updated through established workflows and processes over time.  You can access the attached User Guide for more detail by clicking the red About button and scrolling to attachments.
attribution: City and County of San Francisco

address.name: address
address.description: Address or location description of facility

zip_code.name: zip_code
zip_code.description: ZIP Code where facility is located.

block_lot.name: block_lot
block_lot.description: The block and lot number, also known as the Assessor Parcel Number or APN.  For facilities with multiple APNs associated, the lowest numbered APN is used.  This will blank if in the facility is the right-of-way or outside of San Francisco county.

owned_leased.name: owned_leased
owned_leased.description: Indicates if the facility is owned or leased by the City.

dept_id.name: dept_id_for_jurisdiction
dept_id.description: Department ID of the City department with jurisdiction over the facility.

department_name.name: jurisdiction
department_name.description: Jurisdiction: department name of the City department with jurisdiction over the facility.

gross_sq_ft.name: gross_sq_ft
gross_sq_ft.description: Gross square footage of facility (original source: FRRM). Note: Incomplete data, updating as values are determined.

longitude.name: longitude
longitude.description: The longitude of the facility's location.

latitude.name: latitude
latitude.description: The latitude of the facility's location.

supervisor_district.name: supervisor_district
supervisor_district.description: Board of Supervisors District in which the facility is located, if applicable.  Note: there are city facilities that are outside the boundaries of the City and County of San Francisco.

city_tenants.name: city_tenants
city_tenants.description: City departments that are tenants of the facility, separated by a semi-colon.

land_id.name: land_id
land_id.description: Foreign key to City Lands table.

geom.name: geom
geom.description: The geometry/location column which allows the facility to be mapped in Socrata.

data_last_updated.name: data_last_updated
data_last_updated.description: Timestamp when the record (row) was last updated in the source system

data_as_of.name: data_as_of
data_as_of.description: Timestamp when the record (row) was last refreshed in the source system

data_loaded_at.name: data_loaded_at
data_loaded_at.description: Timestamp when the record (row) was was last updated here (in the data portal)
